sources.full: Los Secretos de las Danzas del FeyWild

item.name: Traveler's Boots
entries: Crafted from exceptionally comfortable and durable materials, these boots allow their wearer to travel great distances.

While wearing these boots, the number of hours you can travel on foot each day before being subjected to the rules for a forced march is doubled. Normally, this increases the limit from 8 hours to 16 hours. If the boots have been worked on by a cobbler and the base limit is 10 hours, the limit instead increases to 20 hours.

item.name: Luxurious Attire
entries: These elegant garments are adorned with intricate details of Alisin silver that catch the light, enhancing the beauty of the wearer.
While wearing these garments, you gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Dazzling Silhouette
entries: While you are in bright or dim light, each creature has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes against you on each turn. This includes light shed by objects.

entries.name: Radiant Elegance
entries: While you are in bright light, you have advantage on Charisma (Performance and Deception) checks and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

item.reqAttune: by a creature with a Charisma score of 13 or higher

item.name: Dancer's Heels
entries: These elegant heels are traditionally worn by members of the mystical lineage of the Danzantes of Glory.
You can use these heels as improvised weapons, following the normal rules for improvised weapons.

item.name: Arcane Heels +1
entries: These magically imbued heels are worn by members of the mystical lineage of Danzantes. Arcane energy flows through them, enhancing the power of their movements.
While wearing these heels, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your spells. In addition, your maximum number of Rhythm uses increases by one.
You can use these heels as improvised weapons, following the normal rules for improvised weapons.
